balls.text: beautifully bowled, and that will be that for KKR with the bat tonight! Ramandeep is the last batter to fall, and Santner is the last to get among the wickets for the hosts! Tosses this one up generously on a length outside off. Plenty of revs on this and the ball drops and dips on Ramandeep late. He has a massive swish at it but is nowhere close to the pitch of the ball, meaning he slices it. Hardik does the rest at short third, and MI have rolled KKR over for 116!
Ramandeep continues to fight! Dragged down outside off and that gets the treatment it deserves. Ramandeep sits deep in his crease and smokes it over long on!
oh! Searing yorker just outside off. Johnson is awfully late on his swing and the ball whistles past the toe-end of his blade. Whistles past off stump too, much to Boult's annoyance
nails the wide yorker. Ramandeep opens his bat face and guides it towards deep point. Happy with the single this time
this is much fuller, almost a yorker. Finishes on leg stump and Ramandeep, looking to heave it away, gets rapped on the pad. Might have pitched outside leg, hence the lack of appeal
zipped in full on off. Ramandeep goes back and across before flicking it towards deep mid wicket. Denies the single, which is probably the right call at this stage
fetch that, says Ramandeep! Seems like another cutter that sits up to be hit on middle and off. Ramandeep opens up his stance and wallops it over deep square leg!

Boult misses a run-out chance! Off-pace on a shortish length just outside off. Ramandeep hacks it to deep mid wicket and calls for two. Johnson is struggling, though, and is only let off because Boult cannot gather
short and wide outside off. Johnson goes back and cuts it towards deep point

another drop by Ashwani! Well, his fielding tonight has not been as good as his bowling! Flighted up on a length on leg stump. Ramandeep sweeps but gets a bit of a top-edge. Arrows it flat towards Ashwani, who makes a mess of it at short fine leg
angled in on a length on the pads. Johnson tucks it away towards deep backward square leg

stunning grab on the fence, and Vignesh Puthur has a wicket too! Dangles the carrot outside off and asks Rana to fetch it. He takes up the challenge but does not succeed. Drags it flat towards deep mid wicket, where Dhir charges in and then swoops forward to snare the chance. Excellent work in the field, and Hardik, along with each of his teammates and thousands at the ground, are over the moon!
very full on the pads. Ramandeep works it towards deep mid wicket. Thinks about two as well but then decides against it
up and over! Floated up full on off and Ramandeep makes the bowler pay. Swings through the line and crashes it over extra cover!

slowed up nicely on a length outside off. Rana has a wild yahoo across the line and only connects with the fresh Mumbai air. Sharp work by Rickelton to take off the bails but Rana had his back foot grounded behind the line
shortish just outside off. Rana gets decent purchase on the cut but cannot get it past backward point
back of a length on leg stump. Ramandeep prods it off the inside edge towards mid wicket and Rana is alert enough to sneak in a single
back of a length on middle and leg. Ramandeep goes back and pats it towards extra cover

edged and safe! Fizzed in on a length on middle and off. Grips in the surface and Rana gets squared up. The ball kisses the outside edge and beats slip. Ashwani chases after it and pulls it back in, despite slipping while he was trying to do so
tossed up on a length on off. Rana stretches forward and drops it into the off side with soft hands
back of a length on off. Rana stays a little leg side of the ball and runs it down to deep third
sharp bouncer outside off that flies through. Rana has a massive waft at it but can only connect with fresh air

hard length on middle and leg. Skips off the surface, rushes onto Rana and he nearly chops it back onto his stumps. Uh-oh, Ashwani has overstepped - that is perhaps his first transgression with the ball all evening

Ashwani has four, would you believe it, and Dre Russ is his latest prey! An astonishing debut, and what an amazing display by the youngster! He set Russell up with the short ball and now goes full. Russell has a wild slog across the line and only swats away a few flies, with the ball thundering into middle stump. KKR are tottering, and Ashwani is having the night of his life in front of thousands at the Wankhede!
short and wide outside off. Russell goes chasing after it and almost swishes himself off his feet. Still cannot make contact
banged in shorter on middle and off. Russell thinks about the good'ol swipe first up but then opts against it. Sways out of the way
Dre Russ with his first boundary! Marginally short just outside off. Russell gives himself room and pounds it past extra cover for four!
very full outside off. Russell jams down on it and squeezes it out behind point to keep srike
tossed up generously on a full length outside off. Russell is drawn into poking at it and sees the ball fizz past the outside edge. He did well to not over-balance there
oh! Back of a length just outside off. Comes in with the angle and skids on, beating Russell for pace on the cut
tossed up full just outside off. Russell comes onto the front foot and plays the perfect forward defence
darted in and this slides just a little down leg. Ramandeep gets inside the line and lets it go. The keeper cannot gather either and KKR get two bonus runs
fired in on a back of a length on the pads. Russell fails to make contact and the ball trickles off his thigh pad into the on side

pinned on the back leg, and the finger goes up! KKR and their nightmare at the Wankhede continues! Looked pretty adjacent but Russell has reviewed because well, why not! Fizzed in on a back of a length on middle and off. The ball grips in the surface and then spins just enough to take it past the outside edge of Russell's bat. He gets smashed on the back leg and Ball Tracking says the ball would have bounced over leg stump. Oh my - what a moment in this game!

oh my word - what an absolute pearler, and this is a debut right out of storybook fantasy for Ashwani! Back of a length on leg stump and Pandey, perhaps expecting another short ball, is caught on the crease. The ball skids off the surface, cuts Pandey in half and then pin-balls off his pad to hit the top of leg stump. Beautiful, beautiful bowling, and KKR are spiraling!
wow, what a shot! Dug in short, finishing just outside off. Pandey skips down the track, stands up tall and cracks it, almost with a straight bat, past mid off!
back of a length on the pads. Russell is a touch late on the flick and the ball rolls off the thigh pad towards deep third
Ashwani welcomes Russell with a bumper outside off. Russell watches it all the way and lets it go. Called a wide too

Ashwani has another, and this IPL debut just got a whole lot better for the youngster from Punjab! Banged in shorter and perhaps a touch wider than the previous ball. Rinku tries to repeat the dose but slices across this way too much. Arrows it towards Dhir, who moves around to his right at deep point and completes the catch with minimal fuss. Rinku is livid with himself, but nothing he can do about it now. KKR slide into further trouble!
smashed! A bit on the shorter side outside off and Rinku reads it early. He slaloms down the track and slaps it disdainfully over extra cover!
shortish on the hips. Pandey tucks it away into the square leg region and picks up another single
back of a length just outside off. This straightens and Pandey hops back to ease it to sweeper cover
back of a length outside off. Comes in with the angle, tucks up Pandey and he stabs it hurriedly towards extra cover
length on leg stump. Rinku brings out the reverse and helps it towards deep point
tossed up on a length on middle and off. Draws Pandey forward and he has to reach out in front to poke it towards sweeper cover
slowed up on a back of a length outside off. Grips and spins back sharply. Rinku is cramped for room and dabs it behind point
short outside off. Rinku throws his hands at it and cuts it on the bounce to backward point
hard length just outside off. Pandey takes a step down the track before tugging it back to Hardik, who picks it up on his follow-through and then fires a throw at the batter's end stumps
dispatched! Another short ball on off and even though this gets up high, this does not have the pace to trouble Pandey. He rides it and then swats it past mid wicket!
banged into the track on middle and off. Pandey spots it early enough and gets out of the way. Good pace and carry, though
shortish outside off. Pandey rises with the bounce and taps it towards backward point
back of a length on off. Rinku gets behind the line and nudges it enough to extra cover's right for a single
pushed in on a length on off. Pandey presses forward and opens his bat face to guide it towards deep point

just over, and Rinku gets his first six! Slowed up on a length outside off. Rinku marches down the track and slams it flat towards long off. Chahar gets his hands up but cannot get his hands to it as such!
tossed up full on off. Rinku gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it straight to extra cover
flighted up full outside off. Pandey plants his front foot and drills it down the ground to long off
Pandey goes bang, and he goes bang early! Dragged down on middle and off. Sits up nicely for Pandey and he pummels it over deep mid wicket!
googly on a short of a length outside off. Pandey hacks it towards deep mid wicket
slanted in on a length on leg stump. Rinku hangs back and turns it behind square

Hardik Pandya brings the Wankhede Stadium to its feet, and KKR sink further into trouble! Badgers that shortish length outside off, daring Raghuvanshi to pull it away. He tries but fails, quite comfortably, it must be added. Wanted to hit it well in front of square but all he could do was find Dhir, running around from deep square leg. KKR five down, and in a whole heap of trouble!
back of a length outside off. Rinku uses the pace and runs it down to deep third
back of a length on leg stump. Rinku steps outside leg, creates room and flays it over backward point. Off the mark with a brace
full on leg stump. Rinku looks to flick it away but jams it off the inside edge into his pads
slanted in a full length on off. Raghuvanshi comes forward and pokes it towards deep square leg
back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi hangs back and dabs it towards backward point
back of a length on leg stump. This seems to come off a little slower than Rinku expects and he plonks it into the on side
banged into the track again, just outside off. Rinku, like Venkatesh earlier in the over, sways out of the way

nicked and gone! Chahar into the act again, and there will be no Venkatesh Iyer heroics tonight against MI! This is on the shorter side, pitching just outside off and then nipping back in. Venkatesh, tentatively, tries to upper-cut it but the inward movement means he gets cramped for room. Glides it straight through to Rickelton in the end, and KKR have lost four in the powerplay!
banged into the track just outside off. Venkatesh gauges the length early and sways out of the way comfortably
back of a length just outside off. Raghuvanshi waits for it and dabs it towards deep backward point
that is a glorious shot! Chahar errs on the fuller side again and Raghuvanshi makes him pay. Shows the full face of the bat and cracks it back past the bowler!

dropped by Ashwani - oh dear! Shortish just outside off. Venkatesh goes flashing at it and slashes it flat towards short third. Ashwani dives forward but the ball pops out of his hands. How costly could that prove to be, given Venkatesh's tendency to score against MI?
fullish just outside off. Venkatesh has a wild swish at it and skews it off the outer half of the bat. Gets enough on it to clear the inner ring (over point) and pick up two
back of a length outside off. Venkatesh presses half forward and jabs it towards cover point
back of a length on middle and leg. Rushes onto Venkatesh, who stabs it off the back foot towards mid wicket
slanted in on a length on off. Venkatesh presses half forward and defends it back towards the bowler
on a length on middle and off. Raghuvanshi is squared up a little and prods it behind point for a single
back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi gets up on his toes and punches it towards deep backward point
Raghuvanshi finds the stands! A touch short outside leg and that is always asking for trouble. Raghuvanshi gets inside the line and dumps it over long leg!
length ball in the channel and this nips away sharply with the angle. Raghuvanshi goes feeling for it and is beaten on the outside

almost a spectacular grab! Hard length just outside off. Venkatesh gives the charge and gives it the kitchen sink. Slices it and Santner hares back from cover point. Flies to take it over his right shoulder but he cannot make it stick. A very tough chance
oh my - what a corker that is! Back of a length outside off. Decks back sharply and cuts Venkatesh in half as he looks to jab it away

and he gets a wicket off his first ball! The outcome of his dreams! This is full and wide, angling across Rahane. He throws his hands at it and slices it towards deep backward point. Tilak settles under it and nearly takes a mess of it. But thankfully for him, the bobble off his first attempt bounces up high enough to allow him to recover. He then shows exemplary reflexes to gobble it up one-handed, and Ashwani gets mobbed by his teammates! The KKR skipper has to go, and Mumbai are overjoyed!
back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi lets the ball come to him before dabbing it towards short third
length outside off. Raghuvanshi gets a half stride in and taps it towards extra cover
banged into the track outside off. Raghuvanshi gets up on his toes and hacks it past mid wicket for a couple of runs
length just outside off. Rahane presses forward and pushes it towards mid off for an easy single
first six of the evening, and Rahane is counter-attacking! Another short ball on leg stump and this only gets up to the waist. Rahane swivels and pulls it over long leg!
dug into the track on leg stump after seeing the batter advance. Raghuvanshi rides the bounce well enough and fends it towards short third
Rahane lands his first punch now! Chahar goes searching for swing and over-pitches again, this time just outside off. Rahane shows the maker's name and thumps it over the non-striker's head!
half-volley on the pads and Rahane will feel he has missed out here. Flicks it straight to mid wicket
pushed in on a length on middle and off. Raghuvanshi drops it into the off side and scampers across to the other end

another cracking shot! This youngster has come to play tonight! Back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi rises with the bounce, gets his hands through the ball and cracks it into the turf and into the gap between cover point and backward point!
off the mark in pristine fashion! Angled in fullish on middle and leg. Raghuvanshi uses the angle and clips it delightfully past mid wicket!

straight to mid off, and the Mumbai Indians are all over the Kolkata Knight Riders like a rash! No real swing, and this pitches on a length outside off. de Kock looks to go downtown but does not get under it enough. Was never trying to keep it down and Ashwani leaps up into the air to take it with both hands above his head. Chahar is delighted, MI are delighted, and thousands of fans in blue are delighted too. KKR under early strife!
full and angled across the batter well outside off. de Kock lets it go and the umpire has to indulge in some early exercise
full just outside off. Rahane goes searching for it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards mid wicket
in-swinging full delivery just outside off. Rahane shows the full face of the bat and drives it neatly towards mid off

Boult smashes middle stump and Narine is outta here early! This is a sizzling delivery. Out-swinging and right in the blockhole. Starts on leg or perhaps just outside and then curves out towards the target. Narine, giving himself room, gets nowhere close to the ball and sees the bails flying everywhere soon after. Another first-over wicket for Boult, and MI are on the board early!
full on off and this moves away late. Narine gives himself room and clinks it off the toe-end towards mid off
fullish on off. Shapes away slightly again and de Kock pushes it towards mid off. Saunters across to get off the mark
back of a length just outside off. A hint of shape away and de Kock gets up on his toes to jab it into the off side

Suryakumar finishes it the only way he can - with another trademark stroke! And Mumbai register another trademark win against the Kolkata Knight Riders, and this is a result that will reverberate around the IPL! Back of a length just outside off. Not sure how Suryakumar does it, but no one in the world does this better than him. Gets down low and then helps it over the keeper's head. A bruising and clinical display and Mumbai, truth be told, have blown the defending champions out of the water tonight!
dug into the track outside off. Rickelton gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point for a single
angled in full on leg stump. Suryakumar comes onto the front foot and flicks it towards deep mid wicket
Suryakumar is after NRR, folks! Banged into the track outside off. Suryakumar arches his back, creates room and upper-cuts it over short third!
Suryakumar is in a hurry! Shortish outside off and that just sits up nicely. He lines it up early and then smears it over mid wicket!
tossed up full on off. Suryakumar gets onto the front foot and flicks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Rickelton goes back and punches it towards long on
back of a length outside off. Nips away off the surface and that takes it past Rickelton's cut
on a length just outside off. Suryakumar sweeps it neatly towards deep backward square leg
that has gone to the fence like a tracer bullet! Flighted up full just outside off. Suryakumar gets down on the sweep and scorches it through square leg!
back of a length on the stumps. Rickelton goes back and eases it to long on
Suryakumar special to get off the mark! Back of a length outside off. Suryakumar picks the line and the length early, bends his back knee to get low and then laps it over the fine leg fence!
back of a length wide outside off. Suryakumar has a loose waft at it and only grabs a handful of fresh air

sharp snare by Rahane, and Jacks has to go! Off-pace on a length outside off. Jacks tries to drive on the up but cannot keep it down. HIts it in the air towards extra cover, where Rahane snaps down low to his right and makes a tough catch look very effortless. Jacks shakes his head as he walks back, and Russell has two!
length ball hung up wide outside off. Jacks backs away and backs away too much in the end. Cannot reach the ball
back of a length on middle and leg. Rickelton knocks it down the ground to long on
length outside off. Jacks presses half forward and pokes it towards mid off
back of a length just outside off. Jacks goes back and nudges it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Jacks waits for it and places it perfectly between long on and deep mid wicket to hurtle back for the brace
slanted in full on middle and off. Rickelton knocks it to long on

this is an even better stroke, despite not going that far! Narine goes full and gets smashed out of sight. Nice, big stride into the stroke and Rickelton snaps his wrists to club it over wide long on!
back of a length on leg stump. Rickelton goes back and turns it towards mid wicket

that has gone an absolute mile! Watch out on Marine Drive! A proper half-tracker on leg stump. Rickelton hops back, opens up his stance and clobbers it over deep mid wicket. Brings up his maiden IPL fifty and does it in style!
fizzed through on a length wide outside off. Jacks has a waft at it and misses
length just outside off. Rickelton hangs back and punches it towards sweeper cover
angled in on a full length wide outside off. Rickelton throws his hands at it but only swishes at thin air
darted in full outside off. Jacks gets down on one knee and paddles it towards deep backward square leg
fired in full o the stumps. Rickelton flicks it down the ground to long on
hung up full and wide. Rickelton looks to go inside-out but the ball straightens enough from around the wicket to go past his flailing blade
length just outside off. Jacks gets onto the front foot and prods it towards extra cover

slight lbw appeal, turned down quickly! But KKR want to have another look! Fizzed in full outside off and this grips sufficiently to spin back into Jacks. Raps him on the front pad, although the ball might have grazed the inside edge on the way. Well well. Does not seem like it on the replay, with the ball missing the ball by a huge margin. Was it doing too much? Ball Tracking reckons so. Clipping leg stump and it is Umpire's Call on the Wickets parameter by the smallest of margins. Jacks survives!
back of a length outside off. Rickelton goes back and taps it towards deep point
right out of the screws! Rickelton is enjoying himself now! Slower on a length just outside off. Rickelton gets down on one knee early and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
pushed in on a length on middle and off. Rickelton flicks it towards short mid wicket
full outside off. Jacks gets a good stride in and eases it down the ground to long off
that is a superb shot! Darted in full on middle and leg. Rickelton brings out the reverse and nails it past backward point. No one moved!
googly on a full length outside off. Jacks stretches forward and turns it past mid wicket
back of a length on middle and leg. Stops a little in the surface and Rickelton pokes it uppishly past the non-striker
length outside off. Jacks comes forward much more confidently and pushes it to long off
angled in on a back of a length on off. Jacks gets behind the line and defends into the on side
fired in on a back of a length on off. Jacks pokes at it tentatively and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards mid wicket
off-pace and into the track outside off. Jacks waits for it and nurdles it into the point region

Jacks is up and running! More catching practice in the stands! Goes short but errs in line. On leg stump and that allows Jacks to get inside the line, use the pace and dump it over the fine leg fence!
hard length just outside off. Rickelton hops up onto his toes and drops it into the off side for a quick single
back of a length outside off. Jacks rides the bounce and opens his bat face to guide it to deep backward point

soft, soft dismissal, and that is the first time Russell has gotten the better of Rohit in a T20! Dug into the track outside off and this gets big on Rohit as he tries to flat-bat it over the ring. Right off the bottom of the bat and Rana does the rest at mid off. Rohit, after a slightly scratchy stay, departs, and MI lose their first wicket!
back of a length just outside off. Rickelton swings for the hills and chalks it off the toe-end towards long on

back of a length outside off and this seems to skip off the surface. A bit of extra bounce too and that takes it past Rickelton's flailing blade. But all that will amount to nothing because Russell has transgressed on the front line. Oh dear!
fizzed in on a length just outside off. Rohit, caught on the crease, stabs at it and jams it off the inside edge into his pads
back of a length on middle and leg. Rickelton goes back and knocks it to long on
short outside off. Rickelton laces his cut but cannot beat the fielder in the ring at cover point. He will feel he missed out there
zipped into the blockhole on leg stump. Rohit tucks it off his toes towards deep backward square leg
what has happened there?! Shortish and down leg. Rohit looks to pull and misses it at the first attempt but then manages to connect with the back of his bat. Ball dribbles towards backward point
back of a length on middle and leg. Rohit hangs back and pushes it towards mid wicket
four more! Rana has lost the plot completely! Low full toss just outside off. Rickelton presses forward, gets his hands through the ball and smashes it to mid off's left!
back of a length on middle and leg. Nips away and that opens Rickelton up completely. He gets a leading edge and the ball bobbles towards short third
full just outside off. Rickelton looks to go downtown again but this time, only swishes at thin air. That zipped past his bat

Rickelton climbs into that, and that is an enormous hit! Banged into the track on off and Rickelton will have that for breakfast, lunch and dinner. He swivels superbly and clatters it over long leg. Almost into the third tier!
that has sped to the fence! Slower ball that lands right in the slot just outside off. Rickelton picks it, plants his front foot and bludgeons it back past the bowler!

appeal for an lbw but surely that pitched outside leg?! Back of a length, pitching just outside leg and finishing on middle stump. Rickelton slogs at it and misses to get pinged on the back leg. Rana says "piche laga hai", which means it has hit the back leg but that has pitched outside leg, confirmed by Ball Tracking
back of a length just outside off. Rickelton gets up on his toes and punches it towards mid off. Keeps strike as well
back of a length, pitching on off and nipping back into Rickelton. He plays all around it and gets pinged on the pad
back of a length just outside off. Rickelton tries to smash this into the Arabian Sea and only connects with fresh air

another miscue and this goes all the way! Rickelton riding his luck early! Dug in shorter outside off. Rickelton has a wild swipe at it and the ball flies off the outside edge over the deep third fence!
Rickelton finds the fence now! Not the most convincing shot he will ever play. Hoicks at this full ball on off and squirts it enough to short fine leg's right!
just over! Back of a length outside off. Rickelton goes fishing at it and skews it just over backward point. Gets a brace for his troubles
back of a length outside off. Rohit waits for it and then scuffs it past point for another brace. Not the greatest connection, but that will do for now
Rohit makes Rana and KKR pay! Attempted yorker outside off but Rana misses on the fuller side. Dishes out a juicy full toss and Rohit bangs it over mid off!
searing in-swinging yorker on middle and leg. Rohit picks it early enough, though, and clips it through mid wicket. And to make matters worse for Rana, he has overstepped...
yorker outside leg. Rickelton gets bat to it and digs it out towards short fine leg. Off the mark at the sixth time of asking
short and wide outside off. A bit of a wild delivery. Rickelton pulls out of his slash at the end and gets the wide
attempted slower yorker on leg stump that ends up being a low full toss. Rohit pokes it towards mid on
angled in again, on a fullish length on middle and leg. Rohit walks across, looks to access the region behind square but does not make contact. Rolls off the front pad into the on side
an absolute jaffa to start! Fullish outside off and this swerves back in with immense whiz. Rohit's turn to get cut in half and he is lucky that has not taken the stumps on the way
back of a length outside off. Rickelton gets up on his toes and taps it towards point

cut in half again! The ball and the bat are speaking different languages here! Hard length, unerringly just outside off. Nips back sharply and Rickelton has no clue as the ball breezes past his inside edge
another play and a miss! Fullish in that corridor of uncertainty. Rickelton goes feeling for it and the ball moves late to beat the outside edge

oof, what a ball! Back of a length in the channel again and this decks back the other way. Rickelton is cut in half this time and QDK does really well to gather to his right, with the ball wobbling all around the place
peach! Back of a length in the channel and this jags away sharply after pitching. Rickelton has a nibble at it and is beaten all ends up
back of a length on leg stump. Rohit lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his pads towards deep backward square leg
